summary: Vodafone Group Plc filed a Form 6-K announcing an agreement to buy out CK Hutchison Group Telecom Holding Limited's 49% stake in the VodafoneThree joint venture for £4.3 billion ($4.9 billion) via a cancellation of shares, making Vodafone the sole owner. VodafoneThree was formed from the merger of Vodafone UK and Three UK, completed on 31 May 2025, with Vodafone holding 51% and CKHGT 49%. Vodafone will fund the buyout with cash, expected to increase net debt to EBITDAaL by 0.4x. Completion is subject to UK National Security and Investment Act approvals, expected in H2 2026. The deal follows integration progress with anticipated £700 million annual synergies by FY30.
